description: Production authentication: OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, rotating short-lived JWTs, secure HTTP-only cookies, and refresh token revocation.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Allowed Co-authored-by identities, one "Name <email>" per line.
# Enforced by .githooks/commit-msg. Only the address inside <> is compared.
#
# Add a line here only for a real collaborator. A wrong address silently
# credits whoever has it verified on GitHub, and refs/pull/* makes that
# permanent.
#
# scm.co_author.email from .agents/oma-config.yaml is allowed automatically
# and does not need an entry here.
